entities.name: Zoltán Harcsa
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Zoltán Ádám Harcsa is a Hungarian middleweight boxer who won bronze medals at the 2013 and 2017 European Championships and the 2015 European Games. He competed at the 2012 and 2016 Olympics, but was eliminated in the second-third bout on both occasions. His brother Norbert is also an international boxer.
